method: All-glyph, per-size natural/quantized fitting against source-balanced outlines; protect the resolvable counters and ink cores of an uncompensated original-source resize at the same new axes and dimensions. Historical 1.400 ink is a separate comparison. Score local ink distortion, contrast and phase variation. Strong fitting is reserved for detail preservation. Direct glyph fallback requires full-range source-detail and bounds validation. No character-name selection rules.
